summary: Skydance Corp filed an 8-K confirming completion on October 6, 2026 of its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery via merger sub Prince Sub Inc., with WBD surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary; the deal was struck February 27, 2026. Skydance then distributed 470,746,773 warrants on a 1:1 ratio to Class B holders of record October 5, 2026, each exercisable at $12.00 per share, listed NYSE as SKYD WS. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or break fee disclosed. Watch warrant overhang and exercise-driven dilution.
